(function() {
    'use strict';

    class PsychologicalSafetyAdapter extends USF.SimulationAdapter {
        constructor() {
            super();
            this.name = 'Psychological Safety Leadership';
            this.version = '1.1.0';
            this.selectedOption = null;
            
            this.MEETINGS = [
                {
                    id: 1,
                    title: `The Kickoff: Who Are We Now?`,
                    title_es: `El Inicio: ¿Quiénes Somos Ahora?`,
                    description: `Week 1. Your first meeting as the new lead. Everyone is watching you. The agenda you inherited is a dense status-update format. You have 15 minutes before the meeting starts.`,
                    description_es: `Semana 1. Tu primera reunión como nuevo líder. Todos te están observando. La agenda que heredaste es un formato denso de actualización de estado. Tienes 15 minutos antes de que comience la reunión.`,
                    decisionContext: `What do you do in the 15 minutes before the meeting?`,
                    decisionContext_es: `¿Qué haces en los 15 minutos antes de la reunión?`,
                    options: [
                        {
                            label: `Option A`,
                            label_es: `Opción A`,
                            text: `Review the inherited agenda and run it as planned. Predictability signals respect for existing norms.`,
                            text_es: `Revisa la agenda heredada y ejecútala según lo planeado. La previsibilidad señala respeto por las normas existentes.`,
                            safetyDelta: 0.3,
                            trustDelta: 0.2,
                            feedback: `The team appreciates the structure, but Valentina and Carlos remain silent throughout. Nothing changes fundamentally.`,
                            feedback_es: `El equipo aprecia la estructura, pero Valentina y Carlos permanecen en silencio. Nada cambia fundamentalmente.`
                        },
                        {
                            label: `Option B`,
                            label_es: `Opción B`,
                            text: `Scrap the agenda for a getting-to-know-each-other session. High relatedness potential, but risk of anxiety without structure.`,
                            text_es: `Descarta la agenda para una sesión de conocimiento. Alto potencial de conexión, pero riesgo de ansiedad sin estructura.`,
                            safetyDelta: 0.8,
                            trustDelta: 0.5,
                            feedback: `Sofia talks non-stop to fill the silence. Diego seems uncomfortable. Some connection happens, but uncertainty lingers.`,
                            feedback_es: `Sofia habla sin parar para llenar el silencio. Diego parece incómodo. Hay cierta conexión, pero persiste la incertidumbre.`
                        },
                        {
                            label: `Option C`,
                            label_es: `Opción C`,
                            text: `Keep first 10 minutes of agenda but add a closing 15-minute structured What's working/What's not round.`,
                            text_es: `Mantén los primeros 10 minutos de la agenda pero agrega un cierre de 15 minutos con ronda estructurada de qué funciona/qué no.`,
                            safetyDelta: 1.2,
                            trustDelta: 0.8,
                            feedback: `Ana raises a concern about testing processes. The team listens. It is a small but meaningful shift toward openness.`,
                            feedback_es: `Ana plantea una preocupación sobre procesos de prueba. El equipo escucha. Es un cambio pequeño pero significativo hacia la apertura.`
                        },
                        {
                            label: `Option D`,
                            label_es: `Opción D`,
                            text: `Send Slack asking each person to prepare one proud moment and one wish for improvement. Signals genuine curiosity and gives introverts time to prepare.`,
                            text_es: `Envía Slack pidiendo a cada uno preparar un momento de orgullo y un deseo de mejora. Señala curiosidad genuina y da tiempo a los introvertidos.`,
                            safetyDelta: 2.1,
                            trustDelta: 1.2,
                            feedback: `Carlos shares detailed insights he had never voiced. Valentina mentions her feature attribution concern. The meeting starts with unprecedented candor.`,
                            feedback_es: `Carlos comparte ideas detalladas que nunca había expresado. Valentina menciona su preocupación sobre atribución. La reunión comienza con una candidez sin precedentes.`
                        }
                    ]
                },
                {
                    id: 2,
                    title: `The Failure: Diego's Deployment Bug`,
                    title_es: `El Fracaso: El Error de Despliegue de Diego`,
                    description: `Week 3. A significant production bug has surfaced in staging. It traces back to a deployment Diego made two weeks ago. Diego has known about the root cause for a week but has not disclosed it. The bug will delay launch by 2 weeks if not addressed.`,
                    description_es: `Semana 3. Un error significativo ha aparecido en staging. Se remonta a un despliegue de Diego hace dos semanas. Diego ha sabido la causa durante una semana pero no lo ha revelado. El error retrasará el lanzamiento 2 semanas si no se aborda.`,
                    decisionContext: `Diego finally admits: "I thought I could fix it quietly." The room goes tense. How do you respond?`,
                    decisionContext_es: `Diego finalmente admite: "Pensé que podía arreglarlo en silencio." La sala se tensa. ¿Cómo respondes?`,
                    options: [
                        {
                            label: `Option A`,
                            label_es: `Opción A`,
                            text: `Diego, this is exactly the kind of thing you need to report immediately. This is unacceptable.`,
                            text_es: `Diego, esto es exactamente lo que debes reportar inmediatamente. Es inaceptable.`,
                            safetyDelta: -2.1,
                            trustDelta: -1.5,
                            feedback: `Diego shuts down completely. Other team members will hide problems more carefully in the future. Fear replaces candor.`,
                            feedback_es: `Diego se cierra completamente. Otros miembros del equipo ocultarán problemas más cuidadosamente. El miedo reemplaza la candidez.`
                        },
                        {
                            label: `Option B`,
                            label_es: `Opción B`,
                            text: `I appreciate you telling us now. Can you walk us through what you were thinking?`,
                            text_es: `Aprecio que nos lo digas ahora. ¿Puedes explicarnos qué estabas pensando?`,
                            safetyDelta: 1.4,
                            trustDelta: 0.8,
                            feedback: `Diego explains the pressure he felt. Others see that candor is rewarded with understanding, not punishment.`,
                            feedback_es: `Diego explica la presión que sintió. Otros ven que la candidez se recompensa con comprensión, no castigo.`
                        },
                        {
                            label: `Option C`,
                            label_es: `Opción C`,
                            text: `That took courage to admit. Let us fix it together — what do we need?`,
                            text_es: `Eso requirió valor para admitirlo. Arreglémoslo juntos: ¿qué necesitamos?`,
                            safetyDelta: 2.0,
                            trustDelta: 1.5,
                            feedback: `Highest safety signal. Diego feels supported. The team rallies to solve the problem collectively. Some worry about accountability standards.`,
                            feedback_es: `Señal máxima de seguridad. Diego se siente apoyado. El equipo se une para resolver el problema colectivamente. Algunos se preocupan por estándares de responsabilidad.`
                        },
                        {
                            label: `Option D`,
                            label_es: `Opción D`,
                            text: `Pivot directly to problem-solving without acknowledging the disclosure.`,
                            text_es: `Pívota directamente a la resolución del problema sin reconocer la revelación.`,
                            safetyDelta: -0.8,
                            trustDelta: -0.5,
                            feedback: `Missed opportunity. Diego feels invisible again. The team learns that vulnerability is ignored, not valued.`,
                            feedback_es: `Oportunidad perdida. Diego se siente invisible de nuevo. El equipo aprende que la vulnerabilidad se ignora, no se valora.`
                        },
                        {
                            label: `Option E`,
                            label_es: `Opción E`,
                            text: `I need to understand the timeline. After this meeting, Diego and I will debrief separately.`,
                            text_es: `Necesito entender la línea de tiempo. Después de esta reunión, Diego y yo hablaremos separadamente.`,
                            safetyDelta: 0.6,
                            trustDelta: 0.3,
                            feedback: `Protects Diego's dignity in the moment but misses the group norm-setting opportunity. Ana feels the risk culture has not changed.`,
                            feedback_es: `Protege la dignidad de Diego en el momento pero pierde la oportunidad de establecer normas grupales. Ana siente que la cultura de riesgo no ha cambiado.`
                        }
                    ]
                },
                {
                    id: 3,
                    title: `The Innovation Session: Who Gets to Have Ideas?`,
                    title_es: `La Sesión de Innovación: ¿Quién Puede Tener Ideas?`,
                    description: `Week 5. You have scheduled a dedicated innovation session for a new integration feature. But conventional brainstorming systematically disadvantages introverts, junior members, and those with lower status — describing 4 of your 8 team members.`,
                    description_es: `Semana 5. Has programado una sesión dedicada de innovación para una nueva función de integración. Pero la lluvia de ideas convencional desfavorece sistemáticamente a introvertidos, miembros junior y de menor estatus — describiendo a 4 de tus 8 miembros.`,
                    decisionContext: `Mateo enthusiastically expands on an idea that was clearly first articulated by Carlos 4 minutes earlier. The group energy goes to Mateo's version. How do you respond?`,
                    decisionContext_es: `Mateo expande entusiastamente una idea que claramente fue articulada primero por Carlos hace 4 minutos. La energía del grupo va a la versión de Mateo. ¿Cómo respondes?`,
                    options: [
                        {
                            label: `Option A`,
                            label_es: `Opción A`,
                            text: `Let it go — ideas should win on merit, not origin.`,
                            text_es: `Déjalo pasar: las ideas deben ganar por mérito, no por origen.`,
                            safetyDelta: -0.5,
                            trustDelta: -0.3,
                            feedback: `Carlos stops contributing entirely. The pattern continues: those who speak loudest get credit. Innovation suffers.`,
                            feedback_es: `Carlos deja de contribuir por completo. El patrón continúa: quienes hablan más fuerte reciben el crédito. La innovación sufre.`
                        },
                        {
                            label: `Option B`,
                            label_es: `Opción B`,
                            text: `Interrupt immediately: "Wait — Carlos, was that not your idea originally? Tell us more."`,
                            text_es: `Interrumpe inmediatamente: "Espera — Carlos, ¿no fue esa tu idea originalmente? Cuéntanos más."`,
                            safetyDelta: 1.0,
                            trustDelta: 0.8,
                            feedback: `Carlos is surprised but elaborates. Mateo is embarrassed publicly. The point about attribution is made, but tension rises.`,
                            feedback_es: `Carlos se sorprende pero elabora. Mateo se avergüenza públicamente. El punto sobre atribución se hace, pero la tensión aumenta.`
                        },
                        {
                            label: `Option C`,
                            label_es: `Opción C`,
                            text: `After the session, update the shared notes to attribute the idea to Carlos.`,
                            text_es: `Después de la sesión, actualiza las notas compartidas para atribuir la idea a Carlos.`,
                            safetyDelta: 0.8,
                            trustDelta: 0.5,
                            feedback: `Carlos notices the attribution in the notes. He appreciates it but wonders why you did not say something in the moment.`,
                            feedback_es: `Carlos nota la atribución en las notas. Lo aprecia pero se pregunta por qué no dijiste algo en el momento.`
                        },
                        {
                            label: `Option D`,
                            label_es: `Opción D`,
                            text: `Develop a team norm on the spot: "Let us build a practice of naming whose idea we are building on."`,
                            text_es: `Desarrolla una norma de equipo en el momento: "Construyamos la práctica de nombrar sobre la idea de quién estamos construyendo."`,
                            safetyDelta: 1.8,
                            trustDelta: 1.2,
                            feedback: `The team adopts the practice. Priya later says this moment made her feel her ideas would be protected. Carlos begins speaking up more.`,
                            feedback_es: `El equipo adopta la práctica. Priya dice después que este momento la hizo sentir que sus ideas serían protegidas. Carlos comienza a hablar más.`
                        }
                    ]
                },
                {
                    id: 4,
                    title: `The Reckoning: Pressure and Launch Decision`,
                    title_es: `El Momento de la Verdad: Presión y Decisión de Lanzamiento`,
                    description: `Week 6. The European parent company CTO demands a briefing. There are three open critical risks. The team trajectory depends entirely on what you have built across meetings 1–3.`,
                    description_es: `Semana 6. El CTO de la empresa matriz europea exige una actualización. Hay tres riesgos críticos abiertos. La trayectoria del equipo depende enteramente de lo que has construido en las reuniones 1–3.`,
                    decisionContext: `Ana raises a serious quality risk that could delay launch by 4 weeks. A message arrives from the European CTO: "We need to confirm launch date by end of day. No more delays." How do you respond to the team?`,
                    decisionContext_es: `Ana plantea un riesgo de calidad serio que podría retrasar el lanzamiento 4 semanas. Llega un mensaje del CTO europeo: "Necesitamos confirmar la fecha de lanzamiento hoy. No más retrasos." ¿Cómo respondes al equipo?`,
                    options: [
                        {
                            label: `Option A`,
                            label_es: `Opción A`,
                            text: `We will confirm the date. We will figure it out.`,
                            text_es: `Confirmaremos la fecha. Lo resolveremos.`,
                            safetyDelta: -1.0,
                            trustDelta: -0.8,
                            feedback: `You have signaled that external pressure overrides team input. Ana stops raising risks. The team goes into silent execution mode.`,
                            feedback_es: `Has señalado que la presión externa anula la opinión del equipo. Ana deja de plantear riesgos. El equipo entra en modo de ejecución silenciosa.`
                        },
                        {
                            label: `Option B`,
                            label_es: `Opción B`,
                            text: `I am going to tell him we need another week and explain why. Team, back me up.`,
                            text_es: `Le diré que necesitamos otra semana y explicaré por qué. Equipo, respáldenme.`,
                            safetyDelta: 1.5,
                            trustDelta: 1.0,
                            feedback: `The team sees you taking a stand for quality. They rally with data to support the request. Trust peaks, but the risk is real.`,
                            feedback_es: `El equipo te ve tomando una postura por la calidad. Se unen con datos para respaldar la solicitud. La confianza llega a su punto máximo, pero el riesgo es real.`
                        },
                        {
                            label: `Option C`,
                            label_es: `Opción C`,
                            text: `What does the team think we should do?`,
                            text_es: `¿Qué cree el equipo que deberíamos hacer?`,
                            safetyDelta: 1.2,
                            trustDelta: 1.3,
                            feedback: `The team discusses trade-offs openly. They own the decision collectively. This is the Learning Zone in action — but it takes time you may not have.`,
                            feedback_es: `El equipo discute las compensaciones abiertamente. Asumen la decisión colectivamente. Esta es la Zona de Aprendizaje en acción, pero toma tiempo que quizás no tengas.`
                        },
                        {
                            label: `Option D`,
                            label_es: `Opción D`,
                            text: `Let us assess: what is the real risk of launching as planned? Ana, Diego — talk to me.`,
                            text_es: `Evaluemos: ¿cuál es el riesgo real de lanzar según lo planeado? Ana, Diego — háblenme.`,
                            safetyDelta: 2.0,
                            trustDelta: 1.5,
                            feedback: `You have modeled that expertise matters more than hierarchy. Ana and Diego provide crucial analysis. The team makes an informed, shared decision.`,
                            feedback_es: `Has modelado que la experiencia importa más que la jerarquía. Ana y Diego proporcionan análisis crucial. El equipo toma una decisión informada y compartida.`
                        }
                    ]
                }
            ];
            
            this.ARCHETYPES = [
                { min: 7.5, key: 'learning_zone', name: `The Learning Zone Leader`, name_es: `El Líder de la Zona de Aprendizaje` },
                { min: 5.5, key: 'well_intentioned', name: `The Well-Intentioned Manager`, name_es: `El Gerente de Buenas Intenciones` },
                { min: 4.0, key: 'efficiency_trap', name: `The Efficiency Trap`, name_es: `La Trampa de la Eficiencia` },
                { min: 2.5, key: 'status_defender', name: `The Status Defender`, name_es: `El Defensor del Estatus` },
                { min: 0, key: 'fear_factory', name: `The Fear Factory`, name_es: `La Fábrica de Miedo` }
            ];
            
            this.TEAM_MEMBERS = {
                valentina: { name: `Valentina`, role: `UX Designer`, states: { low: `Guarded`, mid: `Cautious`, high: `Engaged` }, states_es: { low: `Resguardada`, mid: `Cautelosa`, high: `Comprometida` } },
                diego: { name: `Diego`, role: `Backend Engineer`, states: { low: `Defensive`, mid: `Cautious`, high: `Open` }, states_es: { low: `Defensivo`, mid: `Cauteloso`, high: `Abierto` } },
                sofia: { name: `Sofia`, role: `Product Manager`, states: { low: `Anxious`, mid: `Steady`, high: `Confident` }, states_es: { low: `Ansiosa`, mid: `Estable`, high: `Confiada` } },
                carlos: { name: `Carlos`, role: `Data Analyst`, states: { low: `Invisible`, mid: `Emerging`, high: `Contributing` }, states_es: { low: `Invisible`, mid: `Emergiendo`, high: `Contribuyendo` } },
                ana: { name: `Ana`, role: `QA Lead`, states: { low: `Ignored`, mid: `Heard`, high: `Valued` }, states_es: { low: `Ignorada`, mid: `Escuchada`, high: `Valorada` } },
                mateo: { name: `Mateo`, role: `Frontend Engineer`, states: { low: `Compliant`, mid: `Engaged`, high: `Candid` }, states_es: { low: `Sumiso`, mid: `Comprometido`, high: `Candente` } },
                priya: { name: `Priya`, role: `DevOps Engineer`, states: { low: `Withdrawing`, mid: `Observing`, high: `Committed` }, states_es: { low: `Retirándose`, mid: `Observando`, high: `Comprometida` } },
                roberto: { name: `Roberto`, role: `UX Researcher`, states: { low: `Disengaged`, mid: `Present`, high: `Re-engaged` }, states_es: { low: `Desconectado`, mid: `Presente`, high: `Re-enganchado` } }
            };
        }

        initialize(state) {
            if (!state.domainState || Object.keys(state.domainState).length === 0) {
                state.domainState = {
                    psychologicalSafety: 3.1,
                    trustIndex: 4.2,
                    innovationOutput: 2,
                    launchProbability: 41,
                    safetyHistory: [3.1],
                    trustHistory: [4.2],
                    innovationHistory: [2],
                    memberStates: {
                        valentina: 'guarded',
                        diego: 'defensive',
                        sofia: 'anxious',
                        carlos: 'invisible',
                        ana: 'ignored',
                        mateo: 'compliant',
                        priya: 'withdrawing',
                        roberto: 'disengaged'
                    },
                    decisionsMade: [],
                    currentMeeting: 1,
                    // Contract with express/results_utils.php :: express_resolveDomainScore()
                    // — it reads domainState.performance.overallScore, then a top-level `score`.
                    // v1.0.0 wrote neither, so every participant was graded 0 / "—".
                    score: 0,
                    performance: { overallScore: 0, grade: 'F' }
                };
            } else {
                const _ds = state.domainState;
                if (_ds.score === undefined) _ds.score = 0;
                if (!_ds.performance) _ds.performance = { overallScore: _ds.score || 0, grade: this._grade(_ds.score || 0) };
            }
            if (!state.decisions || Object.keys(state.decisions).length === 0) {
                state.decisions = { selectedOption: null };
            }
            this._updateUI(state);
        }

        validateDecisions(decisions) {
            // Restore a selection made before a page reload (this.selectedOption is
            // adapter-instance state and is NOT persisted; decisions.selectedOption is).
            if (this.selectedOption === null || this.selectedOption === undefined) {
                const checked = document.querySelector('input[name="decisionOption"]:checked');
                if (checked) this.selectedOption = parseInt(checked.value, 10);
            }
            if (this.selectedOption === null || this.selectedOption === undefined) {
                window.mySimulation.uiManager.showNotification(
                    window.mySimulation.t('select_option_warning'), 'warning'
                );
                return false;
            }
            decisions.selectedOption = this.selectedOption;
            return true;
        }

        calculateResults(state) {
            const meeting = this.MEETINGS[state.currentPeriod - 1];
            const option = meeting.options[state.decisions.selectedOption];
            const lang = window.mySimulation.language || 'en';
            
            const safetyDelta = option.safetyDelta;
            const trustDelta = option.trustDelta;
            
            state.domainState.psychologicalSafety = Math.max(0, Math.min(10, 
                state.domainState.psychologicalSafety + safetyDelta));
            state.domainState.trustIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(10, 
                state.domainState.trustIndex + trustDelta));
            
            const innovationBoost = safetyDelta > 1.0 ? 3 : safetyDelta > 0 ? 1 : safetyDelta < 0 ? -1 : 0;
            state.domainState.innovationOutput = Math.max(0, 
                state.domainState.innovationOutput + innovationBoost);
            
            const launchBoost = (safetyDelta + trustDelta) * 2;
            state.domainState.launchProbability = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 
                state.domainState.launchProbability + launchBoost));
            
            state.domainState.safetyHistory.push(state.domainState.psychologicalSafety);
            state.domainState.trustHistory.push(state.domainState.trustIndex);
            state.domainState.innovationHistory.push(state.domainState.innovationOutput);
            
            this._updateMemberStates(state, safetyDelta);
            state.domainState.decisionsMade.push({
                meeting: state.currentPeriod,
                option: state.decisions.selectedOption,
                safetyDelta: safetyDelta,
                trustDelta: trustDelta
            });
            
            const feedbackText = lang === 'es' ? option.feedback_es : option.feedback;
            this._showFeedback(feedbackText, safetyDelta, trustDelta);
            
            this.selectedOption = null;
            
            if (state.currentPeriod >= 4) {
                setTimeout(() => this._showFinalResults(state), 1000);
            }
            
            // Composite 0-100 score, recomputed every meeting and written into
            // domainState in BOTH shapes the PHP grading layer accepts.
            const score = this._computeScore(state.domainState);
            state.domainState.score = score;
            state.domainState.performance = { overallScore: score, grade: this._grade(score) };

            return {
                period: state.currentPeriod,
                meeting: meeting.id,
                safetyScore: state.domainState.psychologicalSafety,
                trustScore: state.domainState.trustIndex,
                innovationOutput: state.domainState.innovationOutput,
                launchProbability: state.domainState.launchProbability,
                safetyDelta: safetyDelta,
                trustDelta: trustDelta,
                score: score,
                overallScore: score,
                finalScore: state.currentPeriod >= (state.maxPeriods || 4) ? score : undefined
            };
        }

        _grade(score) {
            if (score >= 85) return 'A';
            if (score >= 70) return 'B';
            if (score >= 55) return 'C';
            if (score >= 40) return 'D';
            return 'F';
        }

        /**
         * v1.1.0 — NEW scoring exposure (v1.0.0 produced no score at all).
         * Weights follow the debrief narrative: safety is the headline construct,
         * trust the leading indicator, innovation and launch the lagging outcomes.
         */
        _computeScore(ds) {
            const safety = Math.max(0, Math.min(10, ds.psychologicalSafety || 0));
            const trust = Math.max(0, Math.min(10, ds.trustIndex || 0));
            const innovation = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (ds.innovationOutput || 0) * 10));
            const launch = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, ds.launchProbability || 0));
            return Math.round(
                (safety * 10) * 0.40 +
                (trust * 10) * 0.25 +
                innovation * 0.15 +
                launch * 0.20
            );
        }

        _updateMemberStates(state, safetyDelta) {
            const members = state.domainState.memberStates;
            const s = state.domainState.psychologicalSafety;
            
            if (safetyDelta > 1.0) {
                if (members.valentina === 'guarded') members.valentina = 'engaged';
                if (members.diego === 'defensive') members.diego = 'open';
                if (members.carlos === 'invisible') members.carlos = 'contributing';
                if (members.ana === 'ignored') members.ana = 'heard';
                if (members.priya === 'withdrawing') members.priya = 'committed';
                if (members.roberto === 'disengaged') members.roberto = 're-engaged';
            } else if (safetyDelta > 0) {
                if (members.sofia === 'anxious') members.sofia = 'confident';
                if (members.mateo === 'compliant') members.mateo = 'candid';
            } else if (safetyDelta < -1.0) {
                if (members.diego === 'open' || members.diego === 'defensive') members.diego = 'defensive';
                if (members.priya === 'committed' || members.priya === 'withdrawing') members.priya = 'withdrawing';
                if (members.roberto === 're-engaged' || members.roberto === 'disengaged') members.roberto = 'disengaged';
            }
        }

        _showFeedback(text, safetyDelta, trustDelta) {
            const panel = document.getElementById('feedbackPanel');
            const feedbackText = document.getElementById('feedbackText');
            const impactSummary = document.getElementById('impactSummary');
            
            if (panel && feedbackText && impactSummary) {
                feedbackText.innerHTML = text;
                
                const safetyClass = safetyDelta > 0 ? 'positive' : safetyDelta < 0 ? 'negative' : 'neutral';
                const trustClass = trustDelta > 0 ? 'positive' : trustDelta < 0 ? 'negative' : 'neutral';
                const safetySign = safetyDelta > 0 ? '+' : '';
                const trustSign = trustDelta > 0 ? '+' : '';
                
                impactSummary.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="psychsafety-sim-impact-item ${safetyClass}">Psychological Safety: ${safetySign}${safetyDelta.toFixed(1)}</span>
                    <span class="psychsafety-sim-impact-item ${trustClass}">Trust Index: ${trustSign}${trustDelta.toFixed(1)}</span>
                `;
                
                panel.style.display = 'block';
                panel.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }
        }

        _showFinalResults(state) {
            const panel = document.getElementById('finalPanel');
            const archetypeDisplay = document.getElementById('archetypeDisplay');
            const finalMetrics = document.getElementById('finalMetrics');
            const teamOutcomes = document.getElementById('teamOutcomes');
            const lang = window.mySimulation.language || 'en';
            
            if (!panel) return;
            
            const safety = state.domainState.psychologicalSafety;
            const archetype = this.ARCHETYPES.find(a => safety >= a.min);
            const archetypeName = lang === 'es' ? archetype.name_es : archetype.name;
            
            if (archetypeDisplay) {
                archetypeDisplay.textContent = archetypeName;
                archetypeDisplay.style.color = safety >= 7.5 ? '#34d399' : safety >= 5.5 ? '#60a5fa' : safety >= 4.0 ? '#fbbf24' : safety >= 2.5 ? '#f87171' : '#ef4444';
            }
            
            if (finalMetrics) {
                finalMetrics.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="psychsafety-sim-final-metric">
                        <div class="psychsafety-sim-final-metric-label">Final Safety Score</div>
                        <div class="psychsafety-sim-final-metric-value">${safety.toFixed(1)}/10</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="psychsafety-sim-final-metric">
                        <div class="psychsafety-sim-final-metric-label">Trust Index</div>
                        <div class="psychsafety-sim-final-metric-value">${state.domainState.trustIndex.toFixed(1)}/10</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="psychsafety-sim-final-metric">
                        <div class="psychsafety-sim-final-metric-label">Innovation Output</div>
                        <div class="psychsafety-sim-final-metric-value">${state.domainState.innovationOutput}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="psychsafety-sim-final-metric">
                        <div class="psychsafety-sim-final-metric-label">Launch Success</div>
                        <div class="psychsafety-sim-final-metric-value">${Math.round(state.domainState.launchProbability)}%</div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }
            
            if (teamOutcomes) {
                const outcomes = Object.entries(this.TEAM_MEMBERS).map(([key, member]) => {
                    // v1.1.0: was `const state = state.domainState...` — the const shadowed the
                    // `state` parameter, so this threw a TDZ ReferenceError and the whole final
                    // results screen never rendered.
                    const memberState = state.domainState.memberStates[key];
                    const outcomeText = this._getMemberOutcome(key, memberState, lang);
                    return `
                        <div class="psychsafety-sim-team-outcome">
                            <div class="psychsafety-sim-team-outcome-name">${member.name} — ${member.role}</div>
                            <div class="psychsafety-sim-team-outcome-text">${outcomeText}</div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }).join('');
                teamOutcomes.innerHTML = outcomes;
            }
            
            panel.style.display = 'block';
            panel.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        _getMemberOutcome(memberKey, state, lang) {
            const outcomes = {
                valentina: {
                    engaged: lang === 'es' ? 
                        `Esta es la primera vez en 14 meses que siento que mis ideas realmente importan aquí. Me quedé hasta medianoche trabajando en la especificación de integración — no porque tuviera que hacerlo, sino porque quería.` :
                        `This is the first time in 14 months I have felt like my ideas actually matter here. I stayed up until midnight working on the integration spec — not because I had to, but because I wanted to.`,
                    guarded: lang === 'es' ?
                        `He comenzado a actualizar mi CV. Tengo buenas ideas. Me gustaría trabajar en un lugar donde sean escuchadas.` :
                        `I have started updating my CV. I have good ideas. I would like to work somewhere they get heard.`
                },
                diego: {
                    open: lang === 'es' ?
                        `Nunca pensé que podría admitir un error sin sentir que mi carrera terminaba. Este equipo es diferente. Estoy comprometido a hacer que este lanzamiento sea exitoso.` :
                        `I never thought I could admit a mistake without feeling like my career was over. This team is different. I am committed to making this launch successful.`,
                    defensive: lang === 'es' ?
                        `Estoy buscando activamente otras oportunidades. No puedo trabajar en un entorno donde un error te marca para siempre.` :
                        `I am actively looking for other opportunities. I cannot work in an environment where one mistake marks you forever.`
                },
                carlos: {
                    contributing: lang === 'es' ?
                        `Por primera vez, alguien dijo "esta es la idea de Carlos" en una reunión. Casi no sé qué hacer con eso, pero quiero más.` :
                        `For the first time, someone said "this is Carlos's idea" in a meeting. I almost do not know what to do with that, but I want more.`,
                    invisible: lang === 'es' ?
                        `Sigo enviando análisis detallados. Nadie los menciona. He dejado de asistir a las reuniones de equipo.` :
                        `I still send detailed analysis. No one mentions them. I have stopped attending team meetings.`
                },
                ana: {
                    heard: lang === 'es' ?
                        `Mi trabajo de identificación de riesgos finalmente se toma en serio. He comenzado a compartir hallazgos proactivamente en lugar de esperar a que me pregunten.` :
                        `My risk identification work is finally taken seriously. I have started sharing findings proactively instead of waiting to be asked.`,
                    ignored: lang === 'es' ?
                        `Documentaré todo por correo electrónico desde ahora. No confiaré en que las preocupaciones verbales sean registradas.` :
                        `I will document everything by email from now on. I do not trust that verbal concerns will be recorded.`
                },
                priya: {
                    committed: lang === 'es' ?
                        `Cancelé mi entrevista con otra empresa. Esta cultura es rara y valiosa. Quiero ayudar a construirla.` :
                        `I canceled my interview with another company. This culture is rare and valuable. I want to help build it.`,
                    withdrawing: lang === 'es' ?
                        `He solicitado transferencia a otro equipo. No puedo trabajar en un lugar donde guardar silencio es más seguro que hablar.` :
                        `I have requested a transfer to another team. I cannot work somewhere where silence is safer than speaking up.`
                },
                roberto: {
                    're-engaged': lang === 'es' ?
                        `Pensé que este sería otro trabajo donde hacer el mínimo era la estrategia correcta. Me equivoqué. Tengo ideas para la versión 4.0.` :
                        `I thought this would be another job where minimum viable effort was the right strategy. I was wrong. I have ideas for version 4.0.`,
                    disengaged: lang === 'es' ?
                        `Estoy aquí físicamente. Eso es todo lo que pueden esperar de mí.` :
                        `I am here physically. That is all you can expect from me.`
                }
            };
            
            const memberOutcomes = outcomes[memberKey];
            if (memberOutcomes && memberOutcomes[state]) {
                return memberOutcomes[state];
            }
            
            return lang === 'es' ? 
                `Continúa observando la dinámica del equipo, evaluando si es seguro contribuir plenamente.` :
                `Continues observing team dynamics, evaluating whether it is safe to fully contribute.`;
        }

        setupUI(uiManager) {
            uiManager.bind('currentDay', 'currentPeriod');
            uiManager.bind('maxPeriods', 'maxPeriods');
            uiManager.bind('safetyDisplay', 'domainState.psychologicalSafety', 
                (v) => v.toFixed(1) + '/10');
            uiManager.bind('trustDisplay', 'domainState.trustIndex', 
                (v) => v.toFixed(1) + '/10');
            uiManager.bind('innovationDisplay', 'domainState.innovationOutput');
            uiManager.bind('launchDisplay', 'domainState.launchProbability', 
                (v) => Math.round(v) + '%');
            
            this._attachOptionListeners();
        }

        _attachOptionListeners() {
            const options = document.querySelectorAll('.psychsafety-sim-option-btn');
            options.forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    options.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
                    btn.classList.add('selected');
                    this.selectedOption = parseInt(btn.dataset.option);
                    const submitBtn = document.getElementById('nextPeriodBtn');
                    if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = false;
                });
            });
        }

        _updateUI(state) {
            const period = state.currentPeriod || 1;
            const meeting = this.MEETINGS[period - 1];
            const lang = window.mySimulation ? window.mySimulation.language : 'en';
            
            if (meeting) {
                const badge = document.getElementById('meetingBadge');
                const title = document.getElementById('scenarioTitle');
                const text = document.getElementById('scenarioText');
                const context = document.getElementById('decisionContext');
                
                if (badge) badge.textContent = `Meeting ${meeting.id}`;
                if (title) title.textContent = lang === 'es' ? meeting.title_es : meeting.title;
                if (text) text.textContent = lang === 'es' ? meeting.description_es : meeting.description;
                if (context) context.textContent = lang === 'es' ? meeting.decisionContext_es : meeting.decisionContext;
                
                const optionsContainer = document.getElementById('decisionOptions');
                if (optionsContainer) {
                    optionsContainer.innerHTML = meeting.options.map((opt, idx) => `
                        <button class="psychsafety-sim-option-btn" data-option="${idx}" id="opt${idx}">
                            <span class="psychsafety-sim-option-label">${lang === 'es' ? opt.label_es : opt.label}</span>
                            <span class="psychsafety-sim-option-text">${lang === 'es' ? opt.text_es : opt.text}</span>
                        </button>
                    `).join('');
                }
                
                setTimeout(() => this._attachOptionListeners(), 100);
                this._updateTeamGrid(state);
            }
            
            const submitBtn = document.getElementById('nextPeriodBtn');
            if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = true;
            this.selectedOption = null;
            
            const feedbackPanel = document.getElementById('feedbackPanel');
            if (feedbackPanel) feedbackPanel.style.display = 'none';
        }

        _updateTeamGrid(state) {
            const grid = document.getElementById('teamGrid');
            if (!grid || !state.domainState.memberStates) return;
            
            const lang = window.mySimulation ? window.mySimulation.language : 'en';
            
            Object.entries(this.TEAM_MEMBERS).forEach(([key, member]) => {
                const memberEl = document.getElementById(`member-${key}`);
                if (memberEl) {
                    const stateValue = state.domainState.memberStates[key];
                    const stateEl = memberEl.querySelector('.psychsafety-sim-member-state');
                    if (stateEl) {
                        stateEl.dataset.state = stateValue;
                        stateEl.textContent = stateValue.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + stateValue.slice(1);
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        getChartData(state) {
            const labels = state.domainState.safetyHistory.map((_, i) => 'M' + (i + 1));
            return {
                safetyChart: {
                    labels: labels,
                    datasets: [
                        { data: state.domainState.safetyHistory },
                        { data: state.domainState.trustHistory }
                    ]
                }
            };
        }

        getHistoryTableConfig() {
            return [
                { key: 'results.meeting', label: 'Meeting', i18nKey: 'col_meeting' },
                { key: 'results.safetyScore', label: 'Safety Score', i18nKey: 'col_safety', formatter: (v) => v.toFixed(1) },
                { key: 'results.trustScore', label: 'Trust Index', i18nKey: 'col_trust', formatter: (v) => v.toFixed(1) },
                { key: 'results.innovationOutput', label: 'Innovation', i18nKey: 'col_innovation' },
                { key: 'results.launchProbability', label: 'Launch %', i18nKey: 'col_launch', formatter: (v) => Math.round(v) + '%' }
            ];
        }

        getPerformanceSummary(history) {
            if (!history.length) return {};
            
            const final = history[history.length - 1].results;
            const archetype = this.ARCHETYPES.find(a => final.safetyScore >= a.min);
            const lang = window.mySimulation ? window.mySimulation.language : 'en';
            
            let insights = [];
            if (final.safetyScore >= 7.5) {
                insights = lang === 'es' ? 
                    [`Has creado una Zona de Aprendizaje. Tu equipo innovará y retendrá talento.`] :
                    [`You have created a Learning Zone. Your team will innovate and retain talent.`];
            } else if (final.safetyScore >= 5.5) {
                insights = lang === 'es' ? 
                    [`Buenas intenciones pero ejecución inconsistente. Trabaja en la respuesta bajo presión.`] :
                    [`Good intentions but inconsistent execution. Work on your under-pressure response.`];
            } else if (final.safetyScore >= 4.0) {
                insights = lang === 'es' ? 
                    [`Priorizaste la eficiencia sobre las personas. Obtendrás cumplimiento, no compromiso.`] :
                    [`You prioritized efficiency over people. You will get compliance, not commitment.`];
            } else {
                insights = lang === 'es' ? 
                    [`Has creado una Fábrica de Miedo. Los problemas se ocultarán hasta que sea demasiado tarde.`] :
                    [`You have created a Fear Factory. Problems will be hidden until it is too late.`];
            }
            
            const ds = history[history.length - 1].domainState || {};
            const finalScore = (final.score != null) ? final.score : (ds.score || 0);

            return {
                finalScore: finalScore,
                overallScore: finalScore,
                grade: this._grade(finalScore),
                finalSafety: final.safetyScore,
                finalTrust: final.trustScore,
                finalInnovation: final.innovationOutput,
                finalLaunch: final.launchProbability,
                archetype: lang === 'es' ? archetype.name_es : archetype.name,
                insights: insights
            };
        }

        getHint(state, results) {
            const lang = window.mySimulation ? window.mySimulation.language : 'en';
            
            if (state.domainState.psychologicalSafety < 4.0) {
                return lang === 'es' ? 
                    `El equipo está en la Zona de Ansiedad. Busca oportunidades para modelar vulnerabilidad.` :
                    `The team is in the Anxiety Zone. Look for opportunities to model vulnerability.`;
            }
            if (state.domainState.psychologicalSafety > 7.0 && state.currentPeriod < 4) {
                return lang === 'es' ?
                    `Fuerte base de seguridad. Mantén estos comportamientos bajo presión externa.` :
                    `Strong safety foundation. Maintain these behaviors under external pressure.`;
            }
            return null;
        }
